Team —

We need to run a short claim-or-archive sweep in SFDC for all Neptune Health opportunities that show a close date in Q4 but have had no activity in the last 45+ days. Finance is preparing the Q3 close and asks us to lock the forecast within the next 48 hours. Please treat this as time-sensitive.

Action items:
- Owners: claim any opps you are still actively working; add a one-line close plan in the "Next Steps" field and upload close-proof (meeting notes, signed LOI, PO email) to the Drive link below.
- If you are not actively working the opp, change Stage to "Archive (no forecast)" and add a short reason (e.g., "no response since 10/15 - deprioritized").

I pulled a list of 27 Neptune opps flagged by finance (Deal IDs attached in the spreadsheet). I've uploaded the evidence workbook here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-neptune-evidence.

Deadline: 11:59pm PT, Thu Dec 11. Finance will cut the forecast snapshot at 09:00 Fri Dec 12.

Please let me know if you need help validating a close plan — happy to jump on a 15-minute sync.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
